remarks: This unit is located in the highly sought after Mallards Landing complex. The unit was nicely updated 3 years ago and is being freshly painted. There are two parking spots, (Number 115 carport, and Number 19 an assigned uncovered spot).  With two bedrooms, and two baths, washer and dryer in unit, updated kitchen and easy access on first floor, (one flight up from ground level), this is one of the nicest units in the complex. There is a separate storage area for bikes and other items. The deck overlooks the swimming pool in the complex, and there is a dog walking area directly across from the entrance.  Dogs are allowed in the complex, and we would consider one if under 20 pounds, trained and non allergenic. Come see the unit which is available for one year minimum lease. Good credit scores, and references are required. The living room features real hardwood floors, while the bedrooms are carpeted and in excellent condition.
